title: Lymphocyte Mimicry Correction via Region-Level Tissue Reasoning and Unbalanced Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2608.17151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cell mimicry arises when different cell types appear morphologically similar. Human pathologists resolve this ambiguity using surrounding tissue context, whereas current vision models either lack contextual reasoning (cell foundation models) or cannot operate at the cell level (pathology MLLMs). We present Loki-OT, which propagates region-level tissue reasoning to individual cell predictions via Unbalanced Optimal Transport, using MLLM-derived density priors as soft guidance for ambiguous cell reassignment. Loki-OT is motivated by the observation that pretrained cell foundation model features already encode discriminative information, including tissue context, but standard cell-level supervision fails to use tissue context effectively. The resulting transport plan is distilled into a lightweight student MLP classifier that learns context-aware decision boundaries within the pretrained feature space. translated_title: 通过区域级组织推理与非平衡最优传输的淋巴细胞模仿校正
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17151v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：细胞模仿是指不同细胞类型在形态上表现出相似性。人类病理学家通过周围组织背景来解决这种模糊性，而当前的视觉模型要么缺乏背景推理能力（细胞基础模型），要么无法在细胞水平上操作（病理学多模态大语言模型）。我们提出了Loki-OT，它通过非平衡最优传输将区域级组织推理传播到单个细胞预测，利用多模态大语言模型导出的密度先验作为模糊细胞重新分配的软指导。Loki-OT的动机源于观察到预训练的细胞基础模型特征已经编码了判别性信息，包括组织背景，但标准的细胞级监督未能有效利用组织背景。所得传输计划被蒸馏到一个轻量级学生MLP分类器中，该分类器在预训练特征空间内学习上下文感知的决策边界。在独立的TCGA-BRCA队列上，
tldr: Loki-OT通过非平衡最优传输将区域级组织推理传播到细胞级预测，并利用多模态大语言模型密度先验指导模糊细胞重新分配，显著提升了细胞分类的上下文感知能力。
en_tdlr: Loki-OT propagates region-level tissue reasoning to cell-level predictions via Unbalanced Optimal Transport, using MLLM-derived density priors to guide ambiguous cell reassignment, enhancing context-aware cell classification.
